answer: Each identity forges a willow artifact, files it publicly, and locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch an auditor checks one filing against the river log: forge log, maker key, and entry must match, or the bond burns. Copies leave one ripple: identical carvings, one key, both burn. 1,000 fakes pay 40,000, lock 70,000, lose 70,000 on a 40,000 pool. Rented artifacts name their maker, so both burn; an honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its share.
